parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end of the time range to query. This is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description:
The filter key.

> For details on supported filter keys and their values, see **Additional information about request parameters**.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the database instance.

parameters.name: NodeId
parameters.description:
The node ID.

- This parameter is applicable only to ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL and PolarDB for MySQL cluster instances. If this parameter is omitted, the log details of the primary node are returned by default.

- For PolarDB-X 2.0, set this parameter to **polarx\_cn** (compute node) or **polarx\_dn** (data node).

parameters.name: PageNo
parameters.description: The page number. Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 10.

parameters.name: Role
parameters.description:
The role of the node in the PolarDB-X 2.0 database instance.

- **polarx\_cn**: compute node.

- **polarx\_dn**: data node.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The beginning of the time range to query. This is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC.
